The '''S-130 Shelter speeder''',<ref name="GAW" /> or '''Naboo scout carrier''',<ref name="Art of TCW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] designed for medical treatment and protection in [[Biohazard|hazardous]] environments.

==Characteristics==
[[File:S130ShelterSpeeder-GaW.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A hazmat team working beside an S-130]]
The S-130 was a large vehicle that was equipped with state-of-the-art medical sensors and equipment. It was designed to treat patients who had been exposed to toxins or diseases, and help investigate locations where the causes of infections were unknown. While inside, people were protected from radiation, poisons, and inhaled diseases.

It was plated vibrant yellow and grey and featured red markings with the [[Naboo royal crest]].<ref name="BSV">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>

==History==
[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] used one of these small ships to travel from [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] to the [[Eastern swamps/Legends|eastern swamps]] in search of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="BSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:S-130 Shelter speeder concept.png|thumb|Concept art of the S-130 Shelter speeder by Russell G. Chong]]
The Naboo scout carrier first appeared in the episode "[[Blue Shadow Virus (episode)|Blue Shadow Virus]]" from the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', released on [[February 13]], [[2009]].<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus Ep Guide old">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode017.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Blue Shadow Virus}}</ref> It was later first identified in [[2009]] as the Naboo scout carrier by ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''<ref name="Art of TCW" /> and the S-130 Shelter speeder by ''[[Galaxy at War]]''.<ref name="GAW" /> It is based on earlier concept art by [[Doug Chiang]] for ''[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace]]'' that was given to the production crew of ''The Clone Wars'' by ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]]. The final design was done by [[Russell G. Chong]]. To give it a typical Naboo look, Chong gave it more flowing and organic lines and the windows of the scout craft were based on the [[Wikipedia:Consolidated PBY Catalina|Consolidated PBY Catalina]] observation plane from [[Wikipedia:World War II|World War II]].<ref name="Art of TCW" />
